chapters.label: Genoa, live
chapters.text: Genoa against Inter, October 2009. Genoa bring it forward, and Javier Zanetti steps in and wins it! He runs with it, Inter break away, and Mario Balotelli scores! Two-nil!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Zanetti closes him down and pokes the ball away. He does not stop. He pushes it into the space Genoa left behind.

chapters.label: El Tractor
chapters.text: They called him El Tractor, because he never stopped running. Head up, he carries it forward and starts the attack!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: after you win the ball, run forward with it to start the attack.
